Use natural language while avoiding overly formal language to improve readability; however, ensure consistency throughout the dialog to maintain focus; use present tense since future states would likely mislead users into thinking the situation exists now; and avoid using jargon, acronyms, abbreviations unless absolutely essential. Finally, check your prompt against relevant sources or ask humans to verify accuracy before proceeding with the request.
